top_signals.title: China Stock Rescue Needs More State Buying to Work, BI Says
top_signals.summary: China’s national team may need to accelerate stock purchases after the benchmark notched a record losing streak, though state-backed buying alone may not be enough to put the market on a sustained recovery, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Korea Neocloud Firm Elice Tops IPO Price in Second-Day Rally
top_signals.summary: South Korean neocloud-service provider Elice Inc.’s shares rose for a second straight day, climbing above their IPO price and suggesting investors remain committed to the AI trade despite surging industry spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Jio IPO Sees Overwhelming Demand on Day One Even as Nifty Struggles
top_signals.summary: The enthusiasm for Jio’s IPO stands in sharp contrast to the Reliance group’s recent stock-market performance.
